talk.boss: Long-winded. The gaps are narrow, so wait for the very end of a line.
talk.neighbor: Questions come back to back. Nod along quickly.
talk.clerk: Notices the moment your smile slips.
talk.hairdresser: Notices the moment your smile slips.
talk.elder: A few good nods and they're happy.
talk.upstairs: They're awkward too. No need to rush.
talk.petOwner: It's about my cat, so answering is a bit easier.
talk.coworker: Weekend talk. Short answers are fine.
talk.acquaintance: Can't remember their name. Keep answers short.
talk.promoter: They're working. Plenty of room to slip away [4].

talk.surveyor: "Just one minute" is never one minute. Watch for the gap.

talk.florist: A person of few words. No hurry.
talk.manager: Wants to deliver the notice in person. Hear it out.
talk.kid: Say hi back and they beam.
ach.silence.desc: In the elevator, on the bus. You held out without a word.
ach.parryArtist.desc: Caught the gap five times and slipped out naturally.

ach.cyclist.desc: Rode a bike three times. No one could stop you.
ach.noWarp.desc: Finished the week without 'Make It All Go Away~'.
ach.wellLiked.desc: This week, many people thought well of you.
